In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''attack''' was launched against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Rhen Var Imperial outpost/Legends|listening outpost]] at the [[Rhen Var Citadel|Citadel]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent a team of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] which overran the facility's [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. The team captured the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]]<ref name="Atlas" /> which was able to track [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] movements.<ref name="BF I" /> The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Sabotage at Rhen Var|counter-attacked]] a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later. The follow-up strike resulted in the destruction of the outpost.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack was mentioned in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" /> There is a discrepancy surrounding the outpost. The [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'' features the follow-up battle, and although the game says the Imperial forces were defending the outpost,<ref name="BF I" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' says that the outpost had been captured by the Rebels before it was destroyed in the Imperial attack.<ref name="Atlas" />
